##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 31 July 2026 at 11:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low over the Norwegian Sea. High to the southwest of Iceland, with a ridge to Biscay.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, occasional 5 in the west and south of the area later in the period, becoming variable 3 or less tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, then mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, settling east or southeast 2 or 3, increasing east or northeast 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight becoming slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
